hero.filename: Skylineof Wizarding World Ministry of Magic at night.jpg
hero.caption:
An example of the full-scale street and skyline in The Wizarding World of Harry Potter - Ministry of Magic. The circus tent entrance of Le Cirque Arcanus is in foreground. Behind it is a Haussmann style Paris building, adjacent a steep street like in Montmartre. In distance are replicas of turrets of Basilica of the Sacré-Cœur.
As seen at night. A world in the Universal Epic Universe theme park.

images.filename: The Burning Blade Tavern Epic Universe.jpg
images.caption:
The Burning Blade Tavern is in the Dark Universe world of Epic Universe. A fire show that happens multiple times per hour, weather permitting. The show mimics a scene in the 1931 Frankenstein movie, where a mob sets fire to a windmill containing the monster.
In the show the blades turn at a slow pace, and then begin to turn faster. Fire erupts from the center and spreads. The blades are on fire for about half a minute, and then quickly stop. The blades stop turning for a moment, and then resume slow pace. The show starts with a bell ringing in a nearby tower. The show happens day and night.
images.alt:

images.caption:
The Chronos is the overall portal into the worlds of Universal Epic Universe. The story is that Celestials capture energy from the Sun with this tower, using the orbital mechanics spinning at the top. The Chronos powers the other portals in the park.
Two Celestials are depicted on the sides of the tower. Named Dawn (facing East) and Dusk (facing West).
